patterns.guard: Flag POLYMATH_CHAT_LATENT_FUSION (default-off ⇒ byte-identical retrieval) gates RankedLane capture + fuse_ranked_lanes lineage-aware weighted RRF with bounded local-winner preservation: same physical CandidateEvidence, cap never expanded (backfilled), strict _apply_cap ceiling, fail-open on malformed lanes. test_latent_fusion_seam.py (68 V2 + 51 consumer tests) pins bridge local rank-0 surviving cap 3, degenerating at preserve_top_n=0, duplicate staying ONE candidate, and flag-off union == funnel_union[:cap].

patterns.symptom: On wc07-type queries, an expert chunk a BRIDGE subquery ranked #1 never reached the reranker/C4/C5 — silently dropped from candidates; reproduced end-to-end with a 100-query q0 flood plus a bridge rank-1 EXPERT at cap 50, and at cap 6 via retrieve_candidates (EXPERT absent flag-off, present flag-on).

patterns.guard: Causal replay protocol: counterfactual proven FIRST (flag-off V1 union == flag-on union_ids_uncapped[:cap] on a deterministic fixture), one real retrieval feeding both policies via the _latent_fused_union capture, deterministic discriminator (exactly one adapter call/query, 0 ambiguous HYBRID+WILDCARD, n=10), complete per-candidate differential, and mandated two-level reporting (admission vs architectural utility) so a doc-count null can never be reported as an overall benefit null.
patterns.root_cause: A narrow doc-count null (deep-family admission on WLK-10: 1 gain/1 loss per mode) was generalized into a total-benefit claim. The equal V1-only/V2-only swaps (68/68 HYBRID, 78/78 WILDCARD) are a FIXED-CAP churn artifact, not neutrality. Actual utility: V2 preserved 11–12 lane-winners/mode at local_rank 0 that flatten truncates, displaced ZERO V1-kept candidates; per-query V2-better 1 (HYBRID)/4 (WILDCARD) vs V1-better 0 in both; only cost was the weakest q0-cap tail (v1_pos 105–119/120, 0 winners), answer-level q0_preserved 1.0. The upstream-varied step-5 A/B (+0.20 deep_final_reach) additionally could not be causally attributed to fusion.
patterns.symptom: An earlier report claimed "fusion benefit = zero"; the level-3 causal replay showed V2's architectural utility was actually POSITIVE and asymmetric, and the earlier claim was formally CORRECTED.

patterns.guard: Deadline receipts ride retrieval.degraded on both /chat and /chat/stream and in the stored query receipt (meta.route tags the transport); degraded-receipt parity test among the 27 pure parity tests in test_chat_runtime.

patterns.symptom: A turn whose judge timed out was stored with degraded: [] — the degradation appeared only in the retrieve_done phase event, not in retrieval.degraded or the stored query receipt.

patterns.guard: Unjudged aspects are flagged `unjudged` in the engine receipt and the prompt coverage line instead of reading as covered; tests/determinism/test_chat_regression_suite.py runs the frozen manifest in CI (determinism.yml) and fails on floor regression, drifted recording or deleted instrument.
patterns.root_cause: Aspect coverage treated never-scored and covered as the same state — a judge timeout produced silence instead of a distinct flag.
patterns.symptom: Acceptance finding A1: aspects a timed-out judge never scored were displayed as covered in the aspect-coverage reporting.

patterns.guard: An empty synthesizer resolves to the first OFFERED model, never a hidden provider.
patterns.root_cause: The default-synthesizer resolver fell through to raw catalog order, which includes rows hidden until their API key is set (e.g. OpenCode before OPENCODE_API_KEY).
patterns.symptom: With an empty synthesizer value, _default_synthesizer resolved to a hidden provider's model instead of an offered one (found by the CHAT-UI-SURGICAL-V1 pass).

patterns.guard: Tokens raised so secondary text measures ≥ 5.2:1 on --bg and ≥ 4.6:1 on --bg-3 in all nine themes (light accents ≥ 4.5:1); answer column at full text colour; computed-contrast check on the live bundle across every theme × surface cell.
patterns.root_cause: Per-theme --text-dim / --accent token values sat too close to --bg / --bg-3 across the nine themes, and the secondary tone was used for text that needed full contrast.
patterns.symptom: Owner reported text hard to read and hard to separate from the UI; light themes measured secondary text at 3.8–4.0:1 against the background (minimum 4.5:1).

patterns.guard: STYLE-BOLD-RETIRE-V1 removes the nine clauses (edit dated in the docstring) leaving one bold instruction; pin test asserts the retired phrases are absent from the style prompt and the assembled system message; after: longest span 40 → 6 words, bold share 0.030 → 0.010, pseudo-headings 3 → 0, openings plain 10/10.
patterns.root_cause: The v3.3 style layer's "bold thesis" / "short bold summary sentence" / "bolded headers" / "one sentence" clauses (nine places) fought PRESENTATION-V1 — the model received two opposing instructions about bold.
patterns.symptom: Whole-sentence bold in answers: longest bold span 38–40 words against a ≤ 5 target, bold share max 0.172 → 0.084 (target 0.08, missed by 0.004), 4 standalone bold pseudo-headings.

patterns.guard: GENERATION-BOUND-V1: POLYMATH_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS (default 16000, 0 = none) sent on the chat path; finish_reason recorded in result.meta.generation and the query receipt; `generation / cut / truncated:max_tokens` appended to degraded (answer event, /chat JSON, receipt, UI note); one unbounded retry on `bound refused`; 10 offline tests; the failing fixture now completes at 6,981 chars with finish_reason stop.
patterns.root_cause: LiteLLM sends Anthropic-format providers its DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS 4096 when the caller sets no bound, and deepseek-v4-flash (Alibaba Model Studio) spends most of the budget on reasoning — the visible answer was truncated with the finish reason unreceipted.
patterns.symptom: A live artifact test returned a 66-character answer with no error; a 5,773-char artifact cut mid-sentence at "which is what separates"; 1 of 10 before-probe answers cut; one draft had 3 empty answers.

patterns.guard: scripts/chat_models_setup.py --reconcile keeps snapshot ∩ served (browser User-Agent) and records unserved / served_total / reconciled / models_snapshot; default order proven-first (Alibaba deepseek-v4-flash-0731, then OpenCode big-pickle / mimo-v2.5-free / nemotron-3.5-lightning-free, then Ollama gemma4); catalog 46 → 23 with a canary on served ids.
patterns.root_cause: models.dev's zero-cost list (31 ids) ≠ what https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 serves (GET /models: 70 ids, 8 free); the default was picked from the snapshot, and /models itself returned Cloudflare 403 / 1010 to Python's default User-Agent.
patterns.symptom: The moment the owner's OpenCode key went live, the default glm-5-free answered "Model … is not supported" — every new chat broke.

patterns.guard: DOCUMENT-DELETE-V1 typed-confirmation removal with full receipt: 1,975 chunks, 2,682 Qdrant points, 1,061 evidence rows, 987 orphan facts, 255 parent summaries, 1 run; 68 → 67 documents (DB + /corpora card, query_ready), surviving copy intact, no re-ingest.
patterns.root_cause: Both duplicate-guard layers keyed on exact identity, so an 8-byte difference (a "(1)" filename variant) passed them.
patterns.symptom: A near-identical "… Cinema (1).md" copy of the Sound Design document — 8 bytes apart — was ingested into `cinema`; both duplicate-guard layers were blind to it.

patterns.guard: The endpoint prunes Chunk / Evidence / orphan Fact / REL / Document by the ids Postgres released, with per-kind receipts and a skipped-reason on optional tables; pin test on the five Cypher patterns; live cleanup: reconciler (Document −1, Fact −987, Evidence −1,061) + 7,512 stale chunk receipts removed + reconciler again until Chunk count equals Postgres.
patterns.root_cause: DOCUMENT-DELETE-V1 pruned Chunk nodes by a doc_id property they do not carry (0 deleted) and never touched Document / Fact / Evidence nodes; its optional projection_receipts delete was receipted as a bare `skipped`, so the verify reconciler kept the stale nodes.
patterns.symptom: test_no_derived_node_outlives_its_postgres_row failed after the B2 deletion; Neo4j Chunk count 98,238 vs the Postgres chunk count 96,263.

patterns.guard: The legend skips claim items (the fact still rides the tagless [fact:…] block) and one tag per chunk however many bundle items carry it; after: legend rows 21.5 → 15, unjudged 61 → 0, duplicates 41 → 0, prompt 33.7k → 27.3k chars.
patterns.root_cause: Every bundle item carrying a chunk got its own legend row, so a graph fact's provenance passage entered the legend without ever being judged — duplicated when several items shared a chunk.
patterns.symptom: GRAPH-mode legends carried the assembler's `claim` items: over 10 fixture-B GRAPH turns, 61 unjudged [S#] rows and 41 duplicate rows (legend p50 21.5 rows).

patterns.guard: A conservative lexical structural-noise filter in the candidate engine drops index pages / page-number lists from the fused union before truncation, receipted (noise_dropped / noise_reasons / noise_sample); index-page rows 5 → 0.
patterns.root_cause: The role-based demotion only sees chunks with a region_role, and the VES index chunks carried none — so index noise passed through untouched.
patterns.symptom: Back-of-book index pages and page-number lists survived into the fused union and reached the judged set — 5 index-page legend rows over 10 GRAPH turns.

patterns.guard: LATENT-COMPOSITION-V1: wildcard_finish_budget_s (4 s) and ≤ 8 children per parent per judge call; on a budget miss the top unvalidated parents ship as verified:false bridges (best routing child, source_support: null) receipted verified_bridges / unverified_bridges + a `wildcard / unverified` degradation and a UI "unverified" label — never a silently empty lane (forced 0.05 s budget → 30/30 unverified proves the path).
patterns.root_cause: Eight sequential validations ran behind a contended reranker with no dedicated finish budget: when wildcard_deadline_s expired the lane shipped nothing, with no receipted fallback.
patterns.symptom: WILDCARD returned 0 bridges on 30/30 turns at the 2.5 s default deadline — still 0/30 at 8 s — the frontier was silently abandoned; WILDCARD − HYBRID wall +5.89 s p50 against ≤ +2.0 s; 13/30 turns degraded.

patterns.guard: ✨ now sets budget.latent_enabled and the v2 engine runs lane D LATENT_RESCUE — abstraction/transfer vectors nominate parents whose original children enter the union, fused/judged/composed like any lane, receipted in lane_sizes / funnel_lanes / trace.latent, fail-open; live ✨ turn on chat-retrieval-v2 with lane_sizes.latent_rescue = 15.
patterns.root_cause: The latent flag was wired to the legacy engine selector rather than into the v2 mode composition.
patterns.symptom: Toggling ✨ (req.latent) silently dropped the turn from the chat-retrieval-v2 engine to the legacy v1 path, losing v2 funnel and composition receipts.

patterns.guard: Manifest floors pin the acceptable band; rollback switch POLYMATH_CHAT_RERANK_ROUND_ROBIN=0 restores the old prefix slice; 32 seats recorded as the one corrective attempt (survival 0.889 for +2.6 s, deferred to P1.d).
patterns.root_cause: Round-1 seats for every surfaced document's best fused candidate spread the 24 seats over more documents (judged docs 5 → 9, final-set docs 4 → 6), costing some same-document gold its seat; the first 24-seat attempt was worse (B hit@10 0.600 / MRR 0.505).
patterns.symptom: After the document-fair 24-seat judged prefix, survival-given-union fell below its P1.c value (B 0.852 → 0.778, L 1.000 → 0.933) while all manifest floors held (B hit@10 floor 0.60 / MRR 0.45; L 0.90 / 0.80).

patterns.guard: All nine profile_* lanes run structured: "text" and the response is parsed as plain text instead of relying on provider JSON mode.
patterns.root_cause: Groq rejected the profile-lane requests sent with JSON mode during the 2026-09-07 live backfill, so structured JSON output was unusable for those lanes.
patterns.symptom: First live DOCUMENT-PROFILE-V1 backfill calls failed with Groq HTTP 400 whenever a profile lane used JSON mode.

patterns.guard: rag-compiler-v3.1 treats an unlabeled line under a list tag as a NEW item (ITEM_SPLIT) unless the previous item is visibly open, and splits 'Q: a? B?'; secondary guard is prompt doc-profile-v3.2 requiring a label on every line.
patterns.root_cause: The model omits the label on continuation lines of a list; the old compiler attached those bare lines to the previous item, and it also merged multi-question lines like 'Q: a? B?'.
patterns.symptom: Profile model wrote a field label once and then bare unlabeled lines under it, so list items lost their attribute binding in compiled output.

patterns.guard: Projections are sliced into embedder-sized batches (≤4 texts) before embedding.
patterns.root_cause: The embedder enforces a batch cap of 4 texts per request; the backfill tried to push the ~63-text projection in a single call.
patterns.symptom: The ~63-text profile projection was rejected by the embedder with HTTP 422.

patterns.guard: attempt_lanes = 2 rotated primaries then the fallback lanes in pin order, total ≤4 attempts; only transient pool errors hold the ticket, the rest fail the attempt.
patterns.root_cause: Attempt order placed all six primary lanes ahead of the fallbacks under a ≤4-attempt cap, so with six primaries the fallbacks could never be reached.
patterns.symptom: Gemini fallback 1 and OpenRouter fallback 2 lanes were never attempted; rotation exhausted the attempt budget on primaries first.

patterns.guard: batch_hash/plan_hash now bind planner contract + manifest_hash + per-alias skeleton_hash + combined flag, so identical alias ranges across documents can never share durable batch identity.
patterns.root_cause: Batch/plan hashes did not bind source identity — any two documents whose skeletons alias P0001..P0060 hash identically; with 0054's batch_id = batch_hash and ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, the second document's batches would be treated as already completed.
patterns.symptom: Two different documents could produce the same MapBatch.batch_hash / BatchPlan.plan_hash, letting a restart silently skip one document's mapping work.

patterns.guard: token_feasible_rpm drops the ceiling to 3 above the 15k/request cap, with boundary pins added at the thresholds.
patterns.root_cause: token_feasible_rpm used a TPM-only floor: 4 RPM was kept even when a single request exceeded the 15k-token/request cap, leaving 15,001–17,500-token requests ungoverned.
patterns.symptom: Requests of 15,001–17,500 tokens were silently allowed at 4 RPM, above the intended regime for oversized requests.

patterns.guard: chunk_index is REJECTED loudly as a map key; the S9 worker's parent-load query must select chunk_id, and 0054 keys document_parent_maps.parent_id on chunk_id.
patterns.root_cause: chunk_index is positional (UNIQUE(doc_id,chunk_index)) and unstable across re-ingest; durable parent identity is the content PK chunk_id = chunk_<sha256(doc_id|idx|text)>.
patterns.symptom: Parent-map keys based on positional chunk index would break or point at the wrong parent after a re-ingest.

patterns.guard: Renamed and strengthened map_completeness_hash binds manifest + expected + valid + missing so a 73/90 partial, a different 73/90, and a 90/90 complete all differ.
patterns.root_cause: completeness_hash did not bind manifest + expected + valid + missing, so distinct completion states of the same mapping job were indistinguishable.
patterns.symptom: A 73/90 partial run, a different 73/90 partial, and a complete 90/90 could hash identically, hiding which repair set is owed.

patterns.guard: GROQ-ROUTING-POLICY-V1: groq_accounts.account_states sums both lanes' day usage into one shared AccountState and groq_router.choose keys budget on the account; no round-robin, no key burning.
patterns.root_cause: The six Groq accounts are six capacity domains — each account's groq/compound and groq/compound-mini share ONE RPD/TPM/RPM budget — but routing modeled them as independent per-model pools.
patterns.symptom: Routing treated each (account, model) lane as its own quota pool, so compound and compound-mini on one key could jointly overshoot the account's real budget and trip 429s.

patterns.guard: Rule tightened to \b0\d{2,6}\b (≥3 digits): 021/0217 kept, 02/03 dropped, +1 determinism pin.
patterns.root_cause: The zero-padded-code identifier rule accepted 2-digit strings; real codes in the corpus (021, 0217) have ≥3 digits while bare 2-digit table cells are noise.
patterns.symptom: Live canary on real cinema parents extracted 2-digit table cells like 02/03 as zero-padded identifier codes.

patterns.guard: ParentSkeleton v2 adds deterministic lead_excerpt (first 2 substantive sentences, LEAD_EXCERPT_MAX_WORDS 50) emitted only when heading_path is empty; it enters skeleton_hash → manifest_hash → batch_hash so derived identity changes with the changed MAP input.
patterns.root_cause: select_salient_excerpt picks the strongest sentence ANYWHERE in the parent, so for headingless parents (heading_path empty) the opening thesis never reached the prompt — demonstrated live on the owner's essay (LEAD = opening thesis vs SALIENT = mid-doc criterion).
patterns.symptom: Headingless parents (transcripts / flat windows) were framed for MAP generation only by a mid-document salient sentence, losing the window's opening orientation.

patterns.guard: DEFAULT_BUDGET_TOKENS cut 1000 → 500, pinned by test_default_budget_is_canary_selected_floor (canary: 20/20 groq/compound calls, 0 errors, 5-doc cohort).
patterns.root_cause: Field + research-tag coverage saturates at 500 tokens — the no-first-400-bias gate already met at 500 (late-structure 0.82) — so the 1000 default paid double input cost for nothing.
patterns.symptom: Fingerprint budgets above 500 nearly doubled input cost for no gain: 969→1748 input tokens, and a slight regression at 2000 (14.4 fields / 5.6 tags vs 16 fields / 7 tags at 500).

patterns.guard: Provider namespace fixed; the backfill receipt asserts spread — measured distinct_accounts_used: 6 (map_groq1..6 = 30/1/1/2/2/2) with routing around 429-locked accounts.
patterns.root_cause: route_groq looked up lanes under provider 'cloud' while they are registered under 'llm_cloud', so get_lane always missed and routing degenerated to one lane.
patterns.symptom: Routed parent-MAP backfill pinned to a single Groq account — no spread across the six map_groq lanes.

patterns.guard: Backfill is RPM/RPD-paced and resumable: batch_id = batch_hash with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, partial output durable, and only the sorted missing_aliases re-inferred on resume.
patterns.root_cause: The shared Groq accounts were already heavily loaded that day (67 profiles + 67 qualification runs + prior maps), so compound-mini 429'd and large multi-batch docs could not finish in a single pass.
patterns.symptom: The 4 largest cinema docs (Bruce 297 / Blain 264 / Breakthrough 90 / Anatomy 71 parents) did not fully map in one run — only 4/8 cohort docs fully mapped+projected.

patterns.guard: Paced backfill closes the substrate gap, and S9 dual-read UNIONs shadow candidates with the unrestricted direct child lane (never replaces), covering the k-width ceiling on large docs.
patterns.root_cause: Shadow coverage tracks parent-map backfill completeness in near-lockstep — the gap is unmapped parents, not routing quality: nomination 1.000 and parent-resolve 0.972 held across all 36 probes (mean overlap 0.665, median 143 ms).
patterns.symptom: Shadow-route overlap collapsed on partially-mapped docs: Blain (88/264 = 33% mapped) scored 0.242 overlap and Anatomy (11/103 = 11%) scored 0.017, vs 0.80–1.00 for fully-mapped docs.

patterns.guard: last_reviewed frontmatter added to the plan doc; wiki_worm CI enforces it on wiki documents.
patterns.root_cause: The plan-of-record document was frozen into the wiki without the last_reviewed frontmatter field the wiki_worm gate requires.
patterns.symptom: wiki_worm CI gate failed on commit 6b22a49 when the FINAL-RETRIEVAL-ROUTING-SYNTHESIS-V1 plan was admitted.

patterns.guard: Short-TTL (RESERVATION_TTL_S=6s) in-process reservation in groq_routing.route: each pick recorded per account, pending picks injected as extra in_flight so a simultaneous burst rotates across all six accounts; reset_reservations() for isolation; test_route_spreads_a_concurrent_burst_across_accounts (60 concurrent -> exactly 10/account) + test_reservation_decays_... (27/27 green).
patterns.root_cause: N concurrent callers read the same fresh capacity snapshot, so the -in_flight tie-break in groq_router.choose saw zero in-flight for every caller and each picked the lexicographically-smallest account.
patterns.symptom: A c=3 parent-MAP backfill pass put 633/640 map calls on map_groq1 (+13 maps vs sequential, worse than running sequential); 60 concurrent route() calls all landed on one account.

patterns.guard: BACKFILL-SPREAD-V1: explicit round-robin across the six distinct-account endpoints, each with its own AIMD limiter; test_parent_map_backfill_spread.py pins 10/account and empty-pool raises; live-verified even spread 110/110/110/109/109/109.
patterns.root_cause: parent_map_backfill.py::_routed_infer routed via route(), whose capacity view is BLIND for map lanes in a dedicated process: unregistered limiter lanes -> tied placeholders, and the 6s reservation expires during real (long) calls -> lexical-first pin.
patterns.symptom: At backfill scale, 649/657 map calls in one pass pinned to map_groq1 despite the 11.171 reservation fix.

patterns.guard: MAP_RELIABILITY_CAP=15 in mapping_only_capacity + BATCH_PLANNER_VERSION -> map-batches-v2 (batch_hash changes -> large docs re-batch into 15s; maps persist by map_hash, resumable); test_map_batches pins updated (40 -> [15,15,10]; 60 -> 4x15; 150 -> 10x15); qualified live: Hey Whipple 0 -> 75/469 in one pass (~20x maps/call).
patterns.root_cause: map_batches.plan_batches capped batches by token-envelope alias COUNT (mapping_only_capacity=60) with no input-token cap, but the real ceiling was groq/compound-mini structured-output reliability: 10-15 aliases 100% (10/10, 15/15 x3), >=25 flakily EMPTY/partial despite a ~16KB prompt. The initial input-token-size hypothesis was corrected only after capturing a batch.
patterns.symptom: Large docs mapped ~0 (Ken Dancyger 2/430 parents, Hey Whipple 0/469); 40-alias batches returned EMPTY, 60 -> HTTP_413, even at max_tokens 8000.

patterns.guard: GROQ-MAP-CONTROL-PLANE-REPAIR-V1 conservation chain: distinct PROVIDER_RPD representation + admission gate; _chat returns success headers -> record_success; MappingOutcome + summarize() require all-complete AND zero-internal for PASS; separate lane-selection vs provider-dispatch counters; local faults DEFER (resumable) instead of retry-spin; admit() returns reasoned LimiterDecision; offline replay reconciles selections==admitted+refused, dispatches==admitted. scripts/groq_map_forensic_probe.py (max_attempts=1) verified day_count +1 per dispatch, 0 LIMITER_REFUSED in-probe; forensic hold + owner-review gate before any resume.
patterns.root_cause: It was a LOCAL refusal cascade, not provider exhaustion: durable census = 1,064 batches, 15,773 claims, 95.2% on zero-yield batches, terminal last_error LIMITER_REFUSED 926 vs HTTP_429 11 / HTTP_413 3 / empty-200 1 -- and LIMITER_REFUSED dispatches ZERO HTTP (client.py:425, pre-_chat). Amplifiers: (A) _sync_headers fed daily x-ratelimit-*-requests into the per-minute _rpm bucket; (B) success-path headers dropped so provider RPD was unobservable; (E) errored_docs=0 hid internal failures (docs showed mapped=N/N yet complete=False, e.g. 71/71); (G) lane_counter counted SELECTIONS not dispatches; (F) local refusals spun max_attempts=3 retry waste. Probe later measured all 6 accounts ~246-248 of ~250 RPD remaining -- exhaustion CONTRADICTED.
patterns.symptom: A +0-parent / errored_docs=0 backfill pass was recorded as PROOF the six Groq accounts exhausted daily RPD, triggering a forensic hold that stopped the cinema campaign at ~1254/11993.

patterns.guard: THINKING-CONTROL-V1 enable_thinking:false on the SiliconFlow lanes; scripts/siliconflow_extraction_canary.py asserts thinking_off_ok=true (PASS 3/3, valid JSON with 8 entities + 8 relations per account).
patterns.root_cause: Without enable_thinking:false the model emits reasoning-channel output and the structured extraction comes back empty.
patterns.symptom: A thinking-on Qwen/Qwen3-8B (SiliconFlow) returns an EMPTY extraction response instead of JSON.

patterns.guard: family: groq_acct_N -- six isolated circuits per the routing policy of record; fixed with a failing->passing regression in the 11.185 repair set.
patterns.root_cause: All 12 Groq lanes shared family: groq in the limiter, so one shared circuit breaker treated six independent accounts as one.
patterns.symptom: A backoff on one Groq account cooled all Groq lanes (cross-account circuit contamination).

patterns.guard: Flag-gated auto_map_parents_on_chunks scheduler phase (OUTSIDE STAGE_DAG, NON_BLOCKING) + doc_parent_map_stage_worker with in-run cross-lane failover over the six map_groq accounts (all-dark defers TRANSIENT no-attempt); POLYMATH_DOC_PARENT_MAP_ENABLED default OFF => byte-identical, POLYMATH_DOC_PARENT_MAP_CORPUS scopes canaries away from cinema; offline gate 178 passed/1 skipped + rag_pipeline_canary.py harness.
patterns.root_cause: doc_parent_map (pMAP) was backfill-only -- no scheduler phase minted pMAP tickets on chunking (unlike parent_enrichment).
patterns.symptom: A newly uploaded document could never reach VNEXT_COMPLETE: the readiness floor unresolved_eligible_parents==0 was unsatisfiable because no parent-map tickets existed outside manual backfill.

patterns.guard: Run-resolution fixed to the document's own chunked.v1 run; detail=True adds diagnostic sections; test_document_status* green.
patterns.root_cause: document_status.py resolved the run to the CORPUS's newest chunked.v1 run instead of THIS document's own run.
patterns.symptom: Document status showed wrong graph extraction, projection and elapsed numbers for any document in a multi-doc corpus.

patterns.guard: "dedicated": false on the five lanes; offline proof via build_registry(): GRAPH_EXTRACTION = 18 lanes, enabled+active lanes resolving to dedicated_unpinned = NONE, unreachable_pins() = NONE; the 12 remaining dedicated_unpinned entries all enabled=false.
patterns.root_cause: The five lanes kept "dedicated": true after their pin groups (profile_fallback_gemini1/2) were disabled in 11.193; per llm_extraction/pool.py:68-70,293-294 a dedicated endpoint serves only pinned stages and never joins general sharding. Invisible to 11.193's pin-side check because unreachable_pins() deliberately skips dedicated_unpinned (lane_registry.py:322).
patterns.symptom: After the lane reassignment, /control_plane/pool/GRAPH_EXTRACTION returned 8 Google lanes instead of the declared 12; five enabled + credentialed + ACTIVE lanes (gemini5, gemini5b, gemini6, gemini6b, nvidia) served zero stages -- dead capacity, not display.

patterns.guard: OpenCode EXCLUDED from lane endpoints, established by pre-verifying every candidate through the real LLMExtractionClient before assignment; usable only via the synthesizer's litellm.
patterns.root_cause: Cloudflare 1010 rejects the raw LLMExtractionClient request; only the synthesizer's litellm path passes.
patterns.symptom: The OpenCode endpoint is unusable by the raw extraction client -- Cloudflare 1010 blocks the request.

patterns.guard: semantic_readiness.vnext_readiness(conn, corpus, documents) + additive vnext{verdict,parents{eligible,mapped,excluded,unresolved},pending[]} field on semantic_completion (legacy verdict unchanged, fail-open -> NOT_STARTED on missing substrate); per-document vnext_ready + ordered blockers in /documents/summary and /documents/{id}/status?detail=true.
patterns.root_cause: The frozen query_ready boolean predates vNext readiness and was deliberately not redefined, so it reports true on a corpus that is far from vNext-complete.
patterns.symptom: cinema returned query_ready: true from the legacy control contract while SEMANTIC/VNEXT were INCOMPLETE with 10,176 unresolved parents and only 14/67 documents vnext_ready (rag-canary: COMPLETE/COMPLETE, 10/10, 0 unresolved).

patterns.guard: GAP-4 recorded in the F0 contract inventory rather than papered over; 11.197's dormant-backlog classification (70 open runs split HELD vs ORPHANED, none SUPERSEDED, also_query_ready=0) feeds the fix; standing order: classify by generation/function/corpus before any requeue/cancel.
patterns.root_cause: The control-plane summary counts open runs with no age qualifier and no held-vs-actively-processing distinction (the 63 cinema reconciling runs are HELD behind the forensic hold, not stalled workers).
patterns.symptom: control_plane.summary.processing showed processing: 64 for cinema while those runs were last touched 2026-09-07 -- the UI would paint dormant runs as live.

patterns.guard: 11.185's conservation chain (separate selection/refusal/dispatch accounting) is the structural guard going forward; clearing the hold on this bounded exception is an OWNER decision, not an agent waiver.
patterns.root_cause: A provider response was received but booked as a local refusal, breaking the LIMITER_REFUSED => zero-consumption invariant the 11.187 control plane depends on. Magnitude 3 of 1,077 batches (~3 requests vs ~1,500/day capacity) -- moves neither the RPD conclusion nor the cinema-finish estimate, but fails the owner's completeness bar; independently corroborates the 11.178 large-batch (count 60) partial-map concern.
patterns.symptom: The U-2 closure audit found 3 of 926 terminally-LIMITER_REFUSED batches carrying a raw_response_hash with valid_count=0 -- real provider consumption booked as a LOCAL refusal; one hash is e3b0c44298fc1c14... = SHA-256 of the EMPTY STRING; all three were expected_count=60 batches on REAL parents (2026-09-08). Verdict: U-2 FORENSIC HOLD NOT CLEARED.

patterns.guard: Surfaced as a named criterion in the U-2 FORENSIC CLOSURE audit; forensic hold remains until owner review -- backfill not resumed.
patterns.root_cause: Lease expiry did not release or defer the batch, leaving durable map work claimable by no one (quantified: 6 batches; full root-cause detail lives in the audit report).
patterns.symptom: 6 batches frozen on leases that expired in early September 2026 (finding D-2 of the U-2 closure audit).

patterns.guard: Owner standing order 2026-09-10: classify by generation/function/corpus FIRST, no blind requeue, no blind cancellation; supersession test proved none of the open runs is SUPERSEDED (also_query_ready = 0), forcing an explicit per-run archive/cancel decision; unused archive path identified.
patterns.root_cause: Intake events missing source_name after adapter recovery; a retry re-fails by design, so requeueing is pure waste.
patterns.symptom: 4 ORPHANED intake runs with no document (3 d7-h1-test + 1 cinema, attempts exhausted); the 3 d7 runs re-fail deterministically: LEGACY_EVENT_UNRECOVERABLE intake.v1: missing ['source_name'] after adapter recovery. The archive path exists but is unused -- archived_at/archived_reason NULL on all 9 failed tickets.
